category.name: Music generation
category.description: Generate songs, instrumentals, loops and sound effects from prompts.

entries.name: Beatoven.ai API
entries.auth_hint: API key generated via dashboard (exact header name not published)
entries.desc_en: Generate royalty-cleared background music and sound effects from text prompts via REST API (Maestro).
entries.notes: Public marketing pages don't disclose exact auth header or free-credit amount; requires dashboard signup to see full docs.

entries.name: ElevenLabs Music API
entries.free_tier: shares ElevenLabs account credit pool (limited free credits on sign-up); check pricing for per-track cost
entries.desc_en: Generate original music tracks from text prompts or detailed composition plans via REST API, with commercial licensing.
entries.notes: Endpoint POST /v1/music; models music_v1/v2/v2.5; billed from the same ElevenLabs credit pool as TTS.

entries.name: Loudly API
entries.auth_hint: API key issued on account creation (exact header name not published)
entries.free_tier: free track allowance on signup, then volume-based pay-as-you-go pricing
entries.desc_en: Generate, remix, stem-split, and master music tracks programmatically via REST API.
entries.notes: Vendor lists an MCP server as 'in development' (not yet released) as of this check.

entries.name: Mubert API
entries.auth_hint: customer-id + access-token headers (credentials emailed after checkout)
entries.free_tier: paid only; plans start at $49/mo (100 generations/mo), no free tier
entries.desc_en: Generate streaming or file-based background music from text/image prompts via REST/WebRTC API, 15s-25min tracks.
entries.notes: No self-serve free trial; must purchase a plan before receiving API credentials.

entries.name: Soundraw API
entries.auth_hint: check docs (exact header not publicly disclosed on marketing pages)
entries.free_tier: paid only; Starter plan $29.99/mo for 100 songs/mo, no free tier confirmed
entries.desc_en: Generate royalty-free background music tracks by mood, genre, and duration via REST API for embedding in apps.
entries.notes: Full technical API reference is gated behind sales/docs portal; only an FAQ page and pricing were publicly confirmed.

entries.name: Stable Audio API (Stability AI)
entries.free_tier: shares Stability AI platform credits; 25 free credits on signup, then pay-as-you-go
entries.desc_en: Generate music and sound effects from text prompts via REST API (Stable Audio 2.0 models), up to 3 minutes.
entries.notes: Audio endpoint lives under the same platform.stability.ai API and credit system as Stability's image API; exact endpoint path not independently re-verified this pass.
